title: Cross-team engineering leadership weekly staff notes - 2026-07-06
content:
Meeting: Cross-team engineering leadership weekly staff
Date: 2026-07-06 (Monday)
Time: 10:00 - 11:00 PT
Facilitator: Jordan Patel
Attendees: Jordan Patel, Aisha Khan, Mateo Ruiz, Liang Chen, Sophie Turner, Noah Williams, Kavita Iyer (SRE), Tom Brooks (Platform), Elena Park (Product - Hosted API)

Agenda:
- Quick wins / high-level status (5m)
- Serving runtime updates: release cadence + perf regressions (15m)
- Platform & autoscaling: Dedicated pool changes and rollout plan (10m)
- Observability & SLOs: new dashboards and incident postmortem follow-up (10m)
- Private deployments & compliance: packaging and on-prem checklist (10m)
- Cross-team blockers, action items, risks (10m)
- AOB / parking lot (5m)

Notes / Updates:
1) Quick wins / highlights
- Canary of v1.14.0 runtime completed last week; initial metrics look good: 4% p50 latency improvement on 8k-token profiles for unquantized models. Canary to prod planned Thursday (2026-07-09) pending final runbook updates.
- Observability retention increase (30 -> 90 days) landed for trace index, enabling better regression hunting. Thanks to Sophie & observability team.

2) Serving runtime (Lead: Mateo Ruiz)
- Release status: v1.14.0 candidate pushed to canary. PRs merged: kernel selection optimizer, KV-cache bugfix (GH-PR linked).
- Perf regression note: reported ~8% tail-latency spike on long-context (>4k) workloads in one canary host. Root cause is fallback to slower attention kernel under rare sequence alignment condition. Mateo: tracking with a targeted patch to kernel selector; ETA 48h for hotfix.
- Test coverage: adding synthetic long-seq tests to CI to catch this class of regression. Action: Mateo to add tests and open PR by 2026-07-08.
- Backpressure: ongoing experiments with adaptive batching thresholds look promising (reduced queuing by ~12% during bursts). Need more load tests across Dedicated pools.

3) Platform & Dedicated (Lead: Tom Brooks)
- Dedicated pool provisioning: new n2-reserved GPU nodes scheduled for staging on 2026-07-13. This will relieve the east-coast capacity pressure for enterprise customers.
- Autoscaling policy change (PLT-892): introducing per-tenant burst windows. Rollout plan: staging -> canary (1 tenant) -> gradual ramp. QA checklist in linked Jira.
- Risk: cost model update required to reflect burst discounts; finance sync planned Wednesday. Tom to coordinate with FinOps.

4) Observability & SLOs (Lead: Sophie Turner)
- Dashboards: merged team dashboards for per-model p50/p95/p99, per-route cost breakdowns, and token throughput. Live demo at next Ops sync.
- Incident follow-up: postmortem for 2026-06-28 degraded TPU fallback published; action items include improving fallback telemetry (add finer-grained metrics) and updating runbooks. Kavita to own telemetry ticket.
- SLO proposals: discussion on moving to a weighted SLO by tenant; gathering feedback from CS this week.

5) Private deployments & Compliance (Lead: Liang Chen)
- On-prem packaging: initial appliance image for 1.14.0 built; still pending KMS integration tests.
- Air-gap checklist updated; added explicit licensing/entropy steps per legal review. Targeting first customer PoC in July.
- Blocker: HSM vendor contract negotiation is delaying staging tests. Liang to escalate with Legal.

6) Product / Hosted API (Lead: Elena Park)
- Hosted API: rolling out new streaming protocol improvements next week. Early benchmarks show ~6% end-to-end latency reduction for streaming chat flows.
- Model catalog: Redwood-verified profile for bloom-8k quantized added; documentation draft needs SME review. Elena to assign reviewers.

7) SRE / Reliability (Lead: Kavita Iyer)
- Incidents: two P2 incidents in last two weeks (one fallback, one autoscaler misfire). Both assigned; mitigation work in progress.
- Chaos testing: plan to run controlled chaos (simulate AZ outage) in staging on 2026-07-20. All teams: prepare canary steps and rollbacks.

Cross-team Blockers / Risks
- Kernel selector regression (serving runtime): high priority blocker for prod rollout. Containment plan: narrow canary, disable fallback kernel path if hotfix not ready.
- HSM contract delay impacting Private customer PoC. Legal escalation required.
- Autoscaler burst billing model mismatch with finance assumptions; possible customer PR impact if not aligned.

Decisions Made
- Proceed with canary to limited prod (Thursday 2026-07-09) but gate on hotfix or successful mitigation for long-seq tail-latency (Mateo/Tom to confirm).
- Autoscaler policy PLT-892 approved for staged rollout; Tom to own rollout timeline and FinOps sync.

Action Items (owner - due)
- Mateo Ruiz: open CI test PR to add long-seq synthetic tests (due 2026-07-08).
- Mateo Ruiz / Kernel team: deliver hotfix for attention kernel selector or provide mitigation plan (due 2026-07-08 EOD).
- Tom Brooks: finalize Dedicated staging nodes provisioning plan and cost impact brief (due 2026-07-09).
- Liang Chen: escalate HSM contract with Legal and report status (due 2026-07-08).
- Sophie Turner / Observability: enable finer-grained fallback telemetry and add dashboards for kernel-path metrics (due 2026-07-15).
- Kavita Iyer: coordinate chaos testing plan and runbook updates for 2026-07-20 (due 2026-07-13).
- Elena Park: assign SME reviewers for model catalog doc (due 2026-07-09).

Parking Lot / TBD
- Discussion on weighted SLO by tenant to continue after CS feedback.
- Long-term: evaluate investing in alternative attention kernel vendors/hardware.

Next meeting: 2026-07-13, 10:00 PT

Notes prepared by: Jordan Patel
